shown.message:
Outline revision 5 adopts `idea-review-repo`'s request in `story-repo`#5. I commented on and closed the issue.

- **Headline arm:** the classification of each set now rests on one arm per tier, fixed before the runs: A6 (selection among calibrated and PPI++ arms) for T1 and a new B5 for T2. B5 is the selection among B1–B3, done on folds separate from variance estimation. No other arm decides the classification.
- **Ceiling:** the best-of-arms ratio appears only as a descriptive ceiling beside the headline arm's ratio and the estimated floor. It is a maximum over noisy ratios, so it is biased toward gain.
- **C1 notation:** I changed the C1 row to Brief rev. 7's variance form of the gap, Δ = Var(m(f) − a\* − b\*f). The claim is unchanged.

The venue's corrected float budget matches what the outline already has, so nothing else changed.
